sections.title: Customers
sections.description: Every step from sign-in to approval – with clear to-dos for each phase.

topics.title: Access & Profile
topics.summary: Sign in, choose language, manage notifications, and keep your customer profile up to date.

steps.title: Sign in or register
steps.description: Use the "Login" or "Register" pages. After signing in you land on the customer dashboard.

steps.title: Language & region
steps.description: Switch between DE/EN/ES/FR/IT. Filters, downloads, and help content follow your selection.

steps.title: Profile & company data
steps.description: Open "My Account". Update contacts, phone numbers, and delivery addresses so follow-up questions can be resolved faster.

steps.title: Enable notifications
steps.description: Under "Settings" choose whether to receive status updates by email and enable chat notifications.

steps.title: Security & devices
steps.description: Sign out on shared devices after each session. The system logs recent sign-ins in the "Security" area.

tips: Use bookmarks: every help topic provides a deep link you can share with your team.
If you manage multiple sites, add them as separate addresses so tickets are routed correctly.
Forgot your password? Use the reset link on the login page or contact your representative.

topics.title: Start a complaint
topics.summary: Create a new ticket, complete required fields, upload evidence, and confirm.

steps.title: Start & context
steps.description: From the dashboard click "New Complaint". Select product line and region so the right QA teams are notified.

steps.title: Product & lot
steps.description: Enter article number, lot, production date, and quantity. Required fields are highlighted and validated.

steps.title: Images & documents
steps.description: Attach photos, reports, or delivery notes. Use annotations to highlight affected areas (max 10 MB total).

steps.title: Symptoms & expectation
steps.description: Describe the deviation, when it occurred, and the expected resolution (replacement, credit, analysis).

steps.title: Review summary
steps.description: Check all details. The automatic helper surfaces missing required data and suggests relevant knowledge base articles.

steps.title: Submit & confirmation
steps.description: Send the complaint. You receive a ticket number, email confirmation, and a deep link to the ticket view.

tips: Use draft mode if evidence is missing. Drafts remain for 14 days.
Adding delivery notes improves matching with the production lot.
Check the knowledge base under the form for common issues before you submit.

topics.title: Status, chat & documents
topics.summary: Read status, answer questions, add files, and view decisions.

steps.title: Understand status badges
steps.description: The timeline shows Received, In Progress, Lab Review, Decision, and Closed with timestamps.

steps.title: Chat & follow-ups
steps.description: Respond to the ticket chat. New messages appear in notifications and via email.

steps.title: Upload additional files
steps.description: Add more photos or lab results. Each upload is versioned with date and user.

steps.title: Reports & CAPA
steps.description: Inspection reports, corrective actions, and credits become visible after release. Hidden items are not yet approved.

steps.title: Contact representative
steps.description: Use the "Contact representative" button for urgent cases. The chat is prioritized and the representative receives a push notification.

tips: Short answers with photos speed up processing.
Use the ticket PDF export to document status and chat history for audits.
Deep links are personalized—share access via roles instead of forwarding links.

topics.title: Knowledge base & downloads
topics.summary: Find articles, browse product catalogs, and contact support without opening a ticket.

steps.title: Search articles
steps.description: Use search in the help area or the knowledge base page. Filter by product, region, or category.

steps.title: Catalogs & forms
steps.description: Download manuals and safety sheets in the product catalog. Visibility follows your region.

steps.title: Contact support
steps.description: If nothing fits, submit the contact form. Your request is saved as a ticket draft for quick handoff.

tips: Save frequently used articles as favorites to pin them on the dashboard.
Download the ZIP export for offline reference when traveling.
Breadcrumbs help you navigate back to related categories quickly.

sections.title: Representatives
sections.description: Prioritize, evaluate, and release customer cases while coordinating with DFS/PRRC.

topics.title: Dashboard & filters
topics.summary: Filter all cases by priority, region, and status and save your views.

steps.title: Login & role switch
steps.description: Sign in to the representative area. The role switch shows whether you see customer or representative context.

steps.title: Set & save filters
steps.description: Combine status, decision, and customer filters. Save frequent filter sets for quick access.

steps.title: Lists & exports
steps.description: Export filtered lists as CSV/PDF. Exports respect the current language.

tips: From the customer profile jump directly to open tickets for that company.
Star urgent tickets to pin them in favorites.
Sort by "Recently updated" to react faster.

topics.title: Ticket work & communication
topics.summary: Ask for details, keep internal notes, and reply safely to customers.

steps.title: Open the ticket
steps.description: Select a ticket. The header shows customer, product, and current phase.

steps.title: Internal notes
steps.description: Add internal comments visible only to DFS/PRRC and representatives to avoid confusing the customer.

steps.title: Customer chat
steps.description: Reply with clear actions. Attach files directly in the chat.

steps.title: Check attachments
steps.description: Uploads are versioned with user and date. Add missing evidence or request it via chat.

tips: Use response templates for recurring guidance (e.g., packaging checks).
Link customers to the exact form section via deep link when data is missing.
Update status only when all data is present to avoid rework.

topics.title: Evaluate & release
topics.summary: Document decisions, manage visibility, and involve PRRC.

steps.title: Capture the decision
steps.description: Open "Evaluate". Record decision, rationale, impacted lots, and optional CAPA.

steps.title: Set visibility
steps.description: Choose whether the result is visible to customers or stays internal. PRRC always has read access.

steps.title: Request approval
steps.description: Send the draft to PRRC. After approval, customers are notified and documents are published according to visibility.

tips: Set a reminder date when evidence is missing.
PRRC note: every decision needs a source (lab report, customer photo, CAPA).
When declining, add preventive advice to avoid repeat issues.

topics.title: Knowledge & catalogs
topics.summary: Use response templates, manuals, and product info in representative context.

steps.title: Filter by segment
steps.description: In knowledge view, filter by segment, region, and language. Saved filters persist for future sessions.

steps.title: Share downloads
steps.description: Share catalogs via deep link. Visibility follows the assigned role; customers only see customer-visible files.

steps.title: Offline package
steps.description: Download the "Offline advisory" bundle to show product notes on-site without internet.

tips: Favorite articles to surface them on the dashboard.
Search by product number to jump straight to matching manuals.
Refresh outdated links—the system flags expiring documents.

sections.title: DFS Users & PRRC
sections.description: Internal space for quality assurance, CAPA control, audits, and permissions.

topics.title: Quality dashboard & routing
topics.summary: Triage incoming tickets, assign QA teams, and monitor SLAs.

steps.title: Intake review
steps.description: Use the admin dashboard to see new tickets with severity and region. Assign QA teams or labs.

steps.title: SLA monitoring
steps.description: Traffic lights show when SLA limits are reached. Escalate tickets to representatives or PRRC.

steps.title: Data quality
steps.description: Flag missing required data. Customers and reps receive automatic prompts to complete details.

tips: Use bulk actions to assign multiple tickets to one lab.
The "PRRC relevant" filter highlights regulatory-risk cases.
CSV exports include audit timestamps for each status change.

topics.title: CAPA, reports & permissions
topics.summary: Create CAPA items, upload reports, and manage visibility and roles.

steps.title: Create CAPA
steps.description: In the admin CAPA dashboard select "New CAPA". Link ticket, root cause, action, owners, and due date.

steps.title: Upload reports
steps.description: Upload lab reports as PDFs. Link them to a ticket, a CAPA, and a visibility level.

steps.title: Check permissions
steps.description: Visibility per document: PRRC-only, Internal (DFS/Representatives), or Customer-visible. Changes create an audit trail.

steps.title: Audit export
steps.description: Export ticket history, decisions, and documents as a ZIP for audits with timestamps and user IDs.

tips: Set reminders for CAPA due dates; owners get email notifications.
Use tags (segment, region) to find reports faster.
Combine multiple tickets into one CAPA when they share the same root cause.

topics.title: PRRC safeguards
topics.summary: Document assessments, approvals, rights, and visibility for audits.

steps.title: Evidence for assessments
steps.description: Attach sources (lab findings, lot checks, customer communication). Each assessment is time-stamped.

steps.title: Document approvals
steps.description: Two-stage flow: representative recommendation and PRRC final approval. Both steps are logged.

steps.title: Control rights & visibility
steps.description: Set visibility per document: PRRC-only, Internal, or Customer-visible. Each change is audited.

steps.title: Share deep links
steps.description: Use signed deep links for audits. Links are time-bound and show the current release state.

steps.title: Export PRRC log
steps.description: Export the PRRC log with all decisions, approvals, sources, and recipients as PDF.

tips: Use the PRRC log as an audit attachment.
Always check visibility before sharing—the app shows the current release level.
For high-risk cases add an internal CAPA reference to simplify later reviews.
